text:
claire_billing: Heads up — ZenithEdge disputed their March invoice, claiming a DR failover caused unintended burst charges in APAC. They attached logs.

maria_finance: paste invoice id + any meter lines pls. we need to see which bucket was used.

claire_billing: INV-ZEN-2026-03. Vendor note: '2/28 22:10 UTC failover to ap-east for 90m; noticed +10% charge vs committed capacity.'

sam_ops: quick look — their reserved pool is us-west only. Failover routing currently does not automatically map reserved capacity cross-region unless explicitly configured.

nate_sre: i pulled metering for that window:
```
meter: customer=zenithedge region=ap-east bucket=burst tokens=340000 ts=2026-02-28T22:18:12Z
meter: customer=zenithedge region=us-west bucket=reserved tokens=1_100_000 ts=2026-02-28T21:05:00Z
```

sam_ops: ap-east burst ~340k tokens. matches their delta.

maria_finance: what's the burst unit rate under their enterprise plan?

sylvia_sales: their plan burst rate = $0.005/token (enterprise flat). Sales also says the customer expected transparent DR behavior. possible mismatch in expectations.

claire_billing: propose provisional credit = 340000 * 0.005 = $1,700 while we investigate. request finance approval.

david_cfo: i'm okay with provisional credit up to $2k for customer experience reasons, log decision and require RCA before finalizing.

nate_sre: filed OPS-6241 to audit failover routing and to add a metadata tag for billing-exceptions for DR events. ETA 48h.

maria_finance: if ops confirms platform bug we convert to formal SLA credit; if config/contract gap, goodwill credit. please capture exact token math in the memo.

sylvia_sales: i'll brief the customer and offer a technical call. keep wording: 'provisional credit subject to RCA'.

metering-bot: export ready s3://redwood-metering/exports/zenithedge/2026-02-28/1825550000-export.csv

claire_billing: applied provisional credit $1,700 and flagged INV-ZEN-2026-03 as under review. sending hold note to customer.

maria_finance: approved — proceed. send memo to david for records when RCA completes.

david_cfo: confirmed. leave thread open until OPS-6241 is closed.

claire_billing: will update here when OPS RCA done. :white_check_mark:
